name: OANDA
summary: Forex, metals and CFD prices from OANDA's v20 REST API: tradeable instruments, live bid/ask pricing and historical candles.

host.description: api-fxpractice.oanda.com for a practice (demo) account token, api-fxtrade.oanda.com for a live account token. Use the host that matches the account the token belongs to.

api_key.description: An OANDA personal access token (fxTrade Account Management Portal > Manage API Access). Sent as an Authorization Bearer header.

notes: Needs an OANDA fxTrade account, practice or live; every data call is scoped to an account ID.
Limit: 120 requests per second per IP, and at most 2 new connections per second; over it returns 429.
Instruments are written BASE_QUOTE with an underscore: EUR_USD, XAU_USD.
Times come back RFC 3339 by default; an Accept-Datetime-Format: UNIX header switches them to Unix seconds.
Only market-data reads are listed; the order, trade and transfer endpoints are left out on purpose.

endpoints.name: List the token's accounts
endpoints.summary: IDs and tags of every account the access token can read.
notes: Use it to find the accountID the other calls need; it reads nothing about balances or positions.

endpoints.name: List tradeable instruments
endpoints.summary: Instruments the account can trade, with display precision, pip location, margin rate and type (CURRENCY, CFD or METAL).

instruments.description: Comma-separated instruments to return, e.g. EUR_USD,XAU_USD.

notes: The list depends on the account's regulatory division.

endpoints.name: Get current prices
endpoints.summary: Latest bid and ask ladders, closeout prices and tradeable status for instruments.

since.description: Only prices that changed after this time (RFC 3339 or Unix seconds).

includeHomeConversions.description: Add conversion factors to the account's home currency; default false.

endpoints.name: Get candles for an instrument
endpoints.summary: Mid, bid and/or ask OHLC candles and tick volume for one instrument.

price.description: Any mix of M (mid), B (bid), A (ask), e.g. MBA; default M.

granularity.description: Candle size: S5 (default) to M (month), e.g. M1, H1, D, W.

count.description: Candles to return, default 500, at most 5000. Leave out when giving both from and to.

from.description: Range start, RFC 3339 or Unix seconds.

to.description: Range end, RFC 3339 or Unix seconds.

smooth.description: Open each candle at the previous close; default false.

includeFirst.description: Include the candle covering from; default true. false helps polling.

dailyAlignment.description: Hour (0-23) daily candles close at, in alignmentTimezone; default 17.

alignmentTimezone.description: Time zone for dailyAlignment; default America/New_York. Times still come back in UTC.

weeklyAlignment.description: Day weekly candles start on; default Friday.

notes: The last candle can be incomplete: check complete on each candle.
Prices are strings, to keep their precision.

endpoints.name: Get the latest candles for several instruments
endpoints.summary: Current and last completed candle for several instrument, granularity and price combinations.

smooth.description: Open each candle at the previous close; default false.

dailyAlignment.description: Hour (0-23) daily candles close at, in alignmentTimezone; default 17.

alignmentTimezone.description: Time zone for dailyAlignment; default America/New_York. Times still come back in UTC.

weeklyAlignment.description: Day weekly candles start on; default Friday.
